title: Invoices
description: Every invoice across your members and companies — paid, unpaid, and drafts in one ledger.
askOwnerOrAdmin: Ask a space owner or admin to manage invoices.

filters.title: Filter invoices
filters.coverageHint: Filters invoices whose billing period overlaps this range. This does not filter by issue date.

bulk.confirmSendDescription: This will email the selected drafts. Invoices in other statuses or without a recipient email will be reported as skipped.
bulk.confirmResendDescription: This will email the selected sent invoices again. Invoices in other statuses or without a recipient email will be reported as skipped.
bulk.statusMismatch: The invoice does not match this action's required status.
bulk.invoiceMissing: The invoice is no longer available.

searchPlaceholder: Search by number, name or company…

emptyState.noInvoicesDesc: Raise one manually, or generate this month's invoices for members on auto-billing.

picker.title: New invoice
picker.description: Pick the member to bill, or start a manual invoice.

actions.portalLinkCopiedDesc: Paste it in WhatsApp, Telegram or email. The member signs in and sees this invoice.
actions.copyPortalLinkFailed: Could not copy the portal link
actions.copyPortalLinkClipboardFailed: Could not access the clipboard. You can copy the link manually below.
actions.copyPortalLinkNoMember: This invoice has no member, so there is no portal to open.
actions.copyPortalLinkDraftTitle: Mark invoice {{number}} as sent and copy the portal link?
actions.copyPortalLinkDraftDescription: The invoice becomes sent (no PDF email). Then we copy a sign-in link the member can open in WhatsApp or Telegram.
actions.copyPortalLinkDraftConfirm: Mark as sent and copy link
actions.copyPortalLinkManualDescription: We could not access your clipboard. Copy this link manually to send it via WhatsApp, Telegram or email:
actions.markAsSentConfirmDescription: The invoice will become read-only and post to the member's balance. The buyer will not receive an email.
actions.markSentFailed: Could not mark invoice as sent
actions.markAsPaidWithoutPayment: Mark paid without a payment entry
actions.markAsPaidWithoutPaymentConfirmTitle: Mark invoice {{number}} paid without a payment?
actions.markAsPaidWithoutPaymentConfirmDescripti: This marks the invoice paid and sets its paid date without creating a payment entry. Invoice processing may still link its Charges and confirm linked bookings.
actions.markedPaidWithoutPayment: Invoice marked paid. No payment entry was created.
actions.markPaidWithoutPaymentFailed: Could not mark invoice as paid
actions.unmarkPaidConfirmDescription: The invoice goes back to Sent and its paid date is cleared. Payments recorded against it are reversed with a counter-entry in Payments (nothing is deleted), and bookings it confirmed go back to Booked unless they are paid otherwise.
actions.unmarkedPaid: Invoice is unpaid again and back to Sent.
actions.unmarkPaidFailed: Could not unmark the invoice as paid
actions.noEmailDesc: Add a contact email to the member profile before sending invoices.
actions.voidDialogDesc: The invoice will be marked as void and become read-only. The invoice number is preserved for your records and won't be reused.

preview.loadFailed: Couldn't load this invoice. Please try again.

editor.title: New invoice
editor.editingDraft: Changes apply to this draft only; the invoice number stays the same.

billTo.title: Bill to
billTo.prefilledHelp: Prefilled from the member profile. Edits here stay on this invoice — save the member's company details in their profile to avoid re-typing.
billTo.manualHelp: Manual invoice — type the recipient details below. Nothing is saved to a member profile.

numberAndDates.title: Number & dates
numberAndDates.collisionSuffixed: <1>{{number}}</1> is already taken by another (non-void) invoice — this draft will save as <3>{{effective}}</3>. Void or delete the conflicting one if you need the bare number.
numberAndDates.overridden: Will save as <1>{{number}}</1>. Voided invoices' numbers are reusable.
numberAndDates.autoSequence: From the org sequence. Edit to override for this invoice — voided numbers can be reused as-is.
numberAndDates.fixedNumber: A draft keeps the number it was created with.

sources.includeSharedPlans: Include plans from members sharing this billing profile
sources.includeSharedCharges: Include charges from members sharing this billing profile
sources.manualEntryHint: Add charges above, or enter invoice lines manually.

planGeneration.title: Generate from plan
planGeneration.description: Split the billing period by calendar month and prorate partial months. Extend “Period to” to bill several months in advance — one line per month.
planGeneration.noPlans: No open-ended monthly desk, virtual-office or private-office plan is payable through this bill-to profile. Weekly, day-pass and custom-length desk bookings are under From charges, or you can enter invoice lines manually.
planGeneration.datesLimited: Dates were limited to the active plan term: {{period}}.
planGeneration.coveredByCharges: {{count}} existing Charge added instead of a monthly line; {{lines}} generated for the days it does not cover.
planGeneration.coveredByCharges_plural: {{count}} existing Charges added instead of monthly lines; {{lines}} generated for the days they do not cover.
planGeneration.coverageLoading: Checking existing Charges for this period…
planGeneration.coverageFailed: Could not load the existing Charges for this period, so plan lines cannot be checked for double billing. Reopen the invoice to try again.
planGeneration.failedDesc: Check the selected plan and billing dates.

unlinkedCharges.title: Unlinked charges
unlinkedCharges.description: Existing Charges that aren't on an invoice yet: those billed to this bill-to profile, plus the member's own bookings and manual charges. Add one to fold it into this invoice instead of retyping it.
unlinkedCharges.empty: No unlinked Charges payable through this bill-to profile.
unlinkedCharges.allPeriodsNote: Charges added from other periods stay on the invoice until the billing period changes.
unlinkedCharges.billedElsewhere_one: {{count}} charge is billed to {{payer}} — switch Bill to to see it.
unlinkedCharges.billedElsewhere_other: {{count}} charges are billed to {{payer}} — switch Bill to to see them.
unlinkedCharges.billedElsewhereCapped: {{count}}+ charges are billed to {{payer}} — switch Bill to to see them.
unlinkedCharges.unlinkedWarningTitle: Invoice saved, but some charges were not linked
unlinkedCharges.unlinkedWarningDesc: {{failedCount}} of {{totalCount}} selected charge(s) could not be attached to the invoice. Check with Alex before sending it — an unlinked charge amount may otherwise be posted again.

payment.title: Payment
payment.bankDetailsConfigured: Bank details from Organization → Billing are included automatically on the PDF footer.
payment.bankDetailsMissing: Tip: add bank details in Settings → Organization → Billing so they appear on every invoice.

notes.title: Notes
notes.placeholder: Thank-you message, payment terms, reference number...

preview.emptyPrompt: Enter a recipient name to generate an invoice preview.

validation.startBeforeEnd: Billing period start must be on or before the end date.
validation.addAtLeastOneLine: Add at least one line with a description.
validation.qtyGreaterThanZero: quantity must be greater than zero

toasts.planChargesLinkDeferred: Plan charges will be linked to this invoice when it is sent.

statement.otherCurrencyNotice_one: {{count}} entry uses another currency and is excluded from the {{currency}} balance.
statement.otherCurrencyNotice_other: {{count}} entries use another currency and are excluded from the {{currency}} balance.

payChoice.title: Pay the whole invoice {{number}}?
payChoice.description: “{{charge}}” is one of several lines on invoice {{number}}. Paying the whole invoice settles every line at once; paying only this charge leaves the rest of the invoice open.

memberList.empty: No past invoices for this member.

export.title: Export invoices
export.description: A CSV of every invoice issued in the chosen month, by issue date — for your accountant. Drafts and void invoices are included with their status.
export.failed: Could not create the CSV file
export.loadFailed: Could not load invoices for this month

autoPage.title: Auto invoicing
autoPage.description: Monthly drafts for members on recurring plans, one per payer. Drafts are not sent until you send them.
autoPage.loadFailed: Could not load this month. Try again.

toInvoice.title: To invoice
toInvoice.description: One draft per payer for this month. Select groups to create only some of them.
toInvoice.empty: Nothing to invoice for this month.
toInvoice.emptyHint: Members appear here once auto-invoicing is on for them and their plans have charges in this month.

existing.title: Already invoiced for this month
existing.description: Invoices drafted or sent for the month shown. Select drafts to send them in bulk.
existing.empty: No invoices for this month yet.

createDialog.title: Create drafts
createDialog.description: Drafts are created for the groups below. Nothing is sent to members.
createDialog.chronology: Invoice numbers must follow issue dates; this date is earlier than invoice {{number}} ({{date}}).
createDialog.dueDateHint: From the payment terms in Billing settings; applies to every draft. Leave empty for no due date.
createDialog.dueBeforeIssue: The due date can't be before the issue date.

toast.createdDesc: Review and send each draft from the list below.

skipReason.missing_charge: a plan charge was removed, check the member's charges
skipReason.not_eligible: no longer eligible (member switched off or billing details missing)
skipReason.unknown_group: no longer due, refresh the page
skipReason.write_failed: could not be created, try again or contact support
skipReason.cycle_not_generated: the plan's charge for this period could not be created

toCreate.title: Charges to create
toCreate.description: These plans wait for a Charge: one was removed, or the cycle was never generated although its invoice date has passed (for example a plan added after the run). Create them here; they are dated today and then drafted like any other.
toCreate.confirmDescription: Each charge is posted to the member's account dated today, at the plan's current price. No invoice is created; the charges then appear under To invoice.

toast.createdDesc: They now appear under To invoice.
toast.skipped_one: {{count}} item was left as it was: it already has a charge, is invoiced or is not due yet.
toast.skipped_other: {{count}} items were left as they were: they already have a charge, are invoiced or are not due yet.

charges.title: Charges without invoice
charges.description: Charges for this month that no draft covers. Each one shows why it is not invoiced yet.
charges.empty: Every charge for this month is covered by an invoice.

missing.title: Missing billing details
missing.description: These members are opted in, but auto-invoicing needs their payer's billing details first.
missing.empty: No opted-in member is missing billing details.

excluded.title: Excluded from auto-invoicing
excluded.description: Auto-invoicing is off for these members, so their charges stay uninvoiced until you turn it on.
excluded.empty: No member is excluded from auto-invoicing.
